evidence.name: Screen field: Color of the empty track
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Color of the empty track" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Color of the empty track
sections.description: Color of the unfilled part of the progress bar — the portion not yet completed. Defaults to light gray (#E0E0E0), which works for most screens. Keep it clearly lighter than the fill color so the user can read their progress at a glance, or match your page background for a subtler look.
